packages.title: JoolzTV
packages.shortDescription: Launcher for your JoolzTV server: Apple TV style interface, profiles and Torrentio sources
packages.description: JoolzTV: the TV launcher for your JoolzTV server. It finds your server at home first, then on your public address, and opens the JoolzTV interface (Apple TV style, up to 12 profiles with one JoolzApp account each, Torrentio sources, your own streaming server). The design and features come from the server, so they update without reinstalling this app. Needs the JoolzTV app on your Umbrel.

packages.title: TV Updater
packages.shortDescription: Keeps your TV apps up to date automatically
packages.description: Keeps the apps on your TV up to date. Checks this repository's feed after the TV starts (and every 24 hours), downloads newer versions over https, checks their sha256, and installs them. Only updates apps already installed; the JoolzTV launcher asks it to update when your server reports a newer version. Needs a rooted TV with Homebrew Channel.

packages.title: TV Tailscale
packages.shortDescription: Puts your TV on your Tailscale network
packages.description: Installs and runs Tailscale on this TV (newest build, sha256 checked) so JoolzTV can reach your Umbrel from anywhere. Sign in with an address opened on your phone or an auth key, start at boot, and optionally forward a tailnet address to the TV itself. Needs a rooted TV with Homebrew Channel.

packages.title: JoolzCCTV
packages.shortDescription: Live CCTV wall on the TV
packages.description: Opens your JoolzCCTV server (home address first, then public) and shows the live camera wall from all your Hikvision, Dahua and RTSP recorders, with remote-control layouts, saved views and full screen. Sign in with your JoolzApp account.

packages.title: Link Test
packages.shortDescription: Test: can a link open or play a video inside the Netflix app?
packages.description: A small test app, separate from JoolzTV. Launches Netflix (and YouTube as a control) with different link styles so we can see which one opens or plays a title directly.
